basic_info.description: Welcome to this beautiful, beachside, 3bd/2ba, 1575 sq ft condo (per the tax record), in the coveted and scenic Outer Richmond neighborhood. An outdoor enthusiast's dream, this prime location is just steps to Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park and Land's End trails. It's also conveniently located next to shopping and super popular Andytown Coffee. Full of natural light, this gorgeous condo features a flexible and expansive floor plan. The living area features a gas fireplace, dining room, and spacious kitchen with stainless steel appliances and room for a breakfast nook or home office area. There are three tranquil and sizable bedrooms with two full bathrooms, including a generous primary suite with dual closets and an oversized vanity. In unit laundry and an attached garage includes one car parking and ample storage. Easy access to public transportation and commuter's corridors. This stunning, move-in ready oceanside home is waiting for its next owners!
